captions.caption: A shirtless man uses a stone to crush clumps of clay on a flat rock.
The man continues breaking the clay into smaller pieces with the stone.
The man uses a smaller stone to finely grind the clay material.
The man starts kneading the clay with his hands on the rock surface.
The man works the clay, pressing and folding it to improve consistency.
The man continues to knead the clay, ensuring it is well-mixed.
The man forms the clay into a large, cohesive lump on the rock.
The man continues to work the clay with both hands to make it pliable.
The man presses down firmly on the clay lump on the flat stone.
The man gathers the remaining clay pieces into the main lump.
The man finishes kneading the clay in the forest setting.
The man picks up the finished lump of clay from the stone surface.
The man places the large lump of prepared clay into a woven basket.
The man adjusts the clay to fit securely inside the basket.
The man stands up and prepares to carry the basket of clay away.
The man walks through the forest carrying the basket of clay.
The man continues walking towards his primitive shelter area.
The man reaches the entrance of his shelter carrying the clay.
The man enters the shelter area to begin the pottery process.
The man approaches a flat stone workspace on the ground.
The man positions the basket over the center of the flat stone.
The man flips the basket over the flat stone to deposit the clay.
The man lifts the basket to reveal the clay lump on the stone.
The man sets the empty woven basket aside on the ground.
The man reaches for a small amount of fine ash nearby.
The man sprinkles the ash onto the surface of the flat stone.
The man begins to spread the ash across the stone's surface.
The man continues to evenly distribute the ash with his hand.
The man finishes preparing the stone surface with a layer of ash.
The man picks up a portion of the clay to start the bowl.
The man prepares to place the clay on the ashed stone.
The man places the clay lump onto the ash-covered stone.
The man begins to flatten the clay with the palms of his hands.
The man presses his thumbs into the center of the clay disk.
The man starts pulling up the edges of the clay to form bowl walls.
The man continues to shape the walls of the shallow clay bowl.
The man rotates the bowl while refining its shape with his fingers.
The man smooths the inner surface of the clay bowl's base.
The man works on evening out the thickness of the bowl's walls.
The man begins to refine the rim of the clay bowl.
The man uses his fingers to smooth the top edge of the rim.
The man dips his fingers into a container of water nearby.
The man applies water to the clay to help smooth the surface.
The man smooths the interior and exterior of the bowl with wet hands.
The man continues to refine the shape and surface of the bowl.
The man carefully smooths the rim with his wet fingers.
The man rotates the bowl on the stone to check for uniform shape.
The man finishes the initial shaping of the bowl's base layer.
The man takes a small piece of clay to create a coil.
The man rolls the clay between his palms to form a long rope.
The man continues to roll and lengthen the clay coil.
The man begins to attach the long clay coil to the bowl's rim.
The man presses the coil onto the top edge of the clay bowl.
The man continues wrapping the coil around the circumference of the rim.
The man blends the coil into the existing rim with his fingers.
The man pinches the clay to secure the coil firmly in place.
The man works his way further around the rim of the bowl.
The man carefully applies the remaining part of the clay coil.
The man finishes adding the first layer of the clay coil.
The man begins to smooth the new layer into the wall of the bowl.
